parameters.content:
PURPOSE
Define measurable KPIs without inventing numerical baselines or targets.

OWNER
GRETEL TRACK B

INPUT CONTRACT
Accumulated payload with recommendations[] and diagnoses[]

OUTPUT CONTRACT
Accumulated payload plus kpis[] conforming to kpi.schema.json; recommendation KPI objects synchronized

STATUS
Phase 2B repository-ready. Inactive by default. No credentials. Deterministic fixture path; no Python execution.

VISIBLE PATH
Action -> desired outcome -> baseline known?
YES -> preserve supplied baseline
NO -> baseline null / unknown
Define measurement method -> structured KPI output.

parameters.jsCode: return items.map(item => ({ json: { ...item.json, baseline: item.json.recommendation.kpi.baseline, baseline_status: 'known' } }));
return items.map(item => ({ json: { ...item.json, baseline: null, baseline_status: 'unknown' } }));
